Package neqsim.process.equipment.stream

Class MechanicalShaft

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.stream.EnergyStream
neqsim.process.equipment.stream.EnergyBus
neqsim.process.equipment.stream.MechanicalShaft
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, ProcessElementInterface, NamedInterface
public class MechanicalShaft extends EnergyBus
Shared rotating shaft that balances mechanical power producers and loads.

In steady state the inherited bus residual is positive when generation exceeds demand and negative when the shaft is under-powered. In transient mode advanceTransient(double) integrates rotational kinetic energy, d(0.5 J omega^2)/dt = Pnet, with optional friction, speed, acceleration, and trip limits.

Version:
2.0
Author:
NeqSim
